_comment: Copy to feldd_cc.config.json to customize. Anything you omit falls back to the daemon defaults. The setup wizard (WIZARD.md) writes this for you.

buttons._comment: Each value is a list of tmux send-keys args, or {"shell": "a command"}, or null = do nothing. Track 1-4 are not listed: in multi mode they select the session; in single mode they are unused.

events._comment: Claude Code hook event -> state. States: idle | working | needs | done.

sessions._assign_comment: multi mode only: PIN a session to a fixed Track LED 0-3. A KEY matches EITHER a tmux session NAME (exact) OR a project PATH (cwd is/under it). Use NAMES if you launch claude from one dir (e.g. home) in named tmux sessions; use PATHS if each session runs in its project dir. Others auto-fill the remaining LEDs.
